terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.body:
Last updated October 2026.

SparkSquad is a SparkTribe product that helps adults keep daily commitments with a small group. By using SparkSquad you agree to these terms.

Who can use SparkSquad. You must be 18 or older. One account per person. Keep your sign-in secure; you are responsible for activity on your account.

Your content. You own the notes, comments, plans and photos you add. You give us permission to store and show them to the members of your squads so the app can work. Remove content at any time; delete your account to remove everything.

Zero tolerance. Do not post harassment, hate, threats, sexual content, spam, or anything illegal, and do not impersonate others. Anyone can report content or block a person. We review reports within 24 hours and remove content and accounts that break these rules, without warning.

Squads. Owners and admins manage their squads and can remove members. Squad chat links point to WhatsApp or Telegram, which have their own terms.

AI and integrations. If you add your own AI key or public handles, requests go from your phone to that provider under its terms. We never receive your AI key.

Paid plans. Plus and Squad Pro are billed by Apple or Google. Manage or cancel in your store account. Prices are shown before you buy.

No guarantees. SparkSquad is provided as is. We work hard to keep it running and your data safe, but we can’t promise it will always be available.

Changes. We may update these terms and will tell you in the app when we do.

Contact. Questions or complaints: use Help & contact in Settings.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.body:
Last updated October 2026.

What we collect. Your email, name, username, avatar colour, timezone, interests and reminder time; the squads you join; your check-ins, notes, reactions, comments and nudges; and push notification tokens. We do not collect phone numbers or contacts.

What stays on your phone. Free photo proofs, your AI key, step counts and verification results stay on your phone. Plus photo proofs are uploaded so your squad can see them and are deleted after 30 days (90 for Squad Pro).

How we use it. To run your squads, show your progress to your squad, send reminders and nudges, keep the service safe, and improve the app with privacy-friendly, anonymous usage counts.

Who sees it. Members of your squads see your name, avatar, check-ins and comments. Public squad listings show the squad name, description and member count. We do not sell your data.

Service providers. Cloudflare (hosting and storage), Resend (sign-in emails), Expo (push delivery) and, if you turn them on, PostHog (anonymous analytics) and Sentry (crash reports). Payments go through Apple or Google.

Retention. Comments are deleted after 30 days (90 for paid squads), notifications after 30 days, exports after 1 day. Old check-ins are rolled up into summaries after a challenge ends.

Your rights. Export your data or delete your account at any time from Settings. Deletion removes your rows, photos and tokens.

Grievances. Contact us through Help & contact in Settings; we respond within 7 days.

licences.body:

guidelines.title: Community guidelines
guidelines.body:
SparkSquad works because squads are kind and honest.

Cheer people on. Reactions, comments and nudges are for encouragement.

Be honest about your check-ins. An honest miss beats a fake tick.

No harassment, hate, threats, sexual content, spam or impersonation. We remove it and the accounts behind it.

Respect privacy. Don’t share other people’s details or photos without asking.

Report anything that breaks these rules. We review every report within 24 hours.

help.title: Help & contact
help.q1: When does a day count as done?
help.a1: When you finish all of the day’s tasks. If your squad allows it, finishing at least half also counts.
help.q2: I missed yesterday. Can I still check in?
help.a2: Yes. You can check in for yesterday until midnight today.
help.a3: You earn one for every 7 days in a row. If you miss a day, a freeze keeps your streak alive.
help.a4: Only members of the squad. Blocked people never see them.
help.q5: Does SparkSquad see my AI key?
help.a5: No. It stays in your phone’s secure keystore and requests go straight to the provider.
help.contactBody: Write to us about anything, including complaints. We reply within 7 days.
